Anna is an environmentalist and is studying the impact of deforestation in a pine forest located in a square-shaped region. Question 18

Anna is an environmentalist and is studying the impact of deforestation in a pine forest located in a square-shaped region. Anna discovers that the area of ​​the deforested region is decreasing at a rate of 0.4 km2/month. At what rate are the region's diagonals decreasing if the diagonals are 20 km long?

a
 0.5 km/month
b
 0.1 km/month
c
 0.25 km/month
d
 0.05 km/month
e
 0.02 km/month
